metadata.purpose: Race source and other Observables, cancel losing sources on the first next; early error/complete terminates.

conditions: The first next from any input elects exactly one winner and the winner contributes all later next values.
An error or completion before any next terminates immediately even if another input may have produced a value later.
After first next, only the winning source may complete or error the result.

scope.parameters: 0..32 additional ordinary Observable inputs; race legacy array/variadic overloads normalized to same candidate order.
scope.callbacks: No user callbacks or result selectors; opaque input values preserve identity.
scope.time: Notifications are ordered by source/scheduler arrival. Race itself creates no timers or scheduler.
scope.reentrancy: Atomic non-reentrant post-setup notifications; every input subscribed in source-first argument order before delivery.
exclusions: Synchronous emission/completion/error during subscription acquisition, which may prevent later candidate subscriptions.
Promises/iterables, errors during input conversion, observer reentrancy, throwing teardown and scheduler-specific interleavings.

initialization.sourceSubscription: A fresh, result-local connection subscribes input 0 then each other input; zero others is identity.

ownership.sharing: No sharing; each downstream subscription creates a new race across inputs.
ownership.reset: Fresh input live set and winner=null per result subscription.

resources.owner: result subscription; generation is fixed input index

dispatch.actionSemantics: First next cancels all earlier/later losing subscriptions before forwarding its payload. Early error/complete terminates all inputs.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between notifications, and immediately on first winner.

controls.description: all candidates live; no first next yet

rules.guard: first result subscription with valid fixed Observable inputs
actions: subscribe source input 0 and then every additional input in order
rules.explanation: Each observer owns one independent race; no producer is shared.
rules.nextState: All source subscriptions live; no winner.

rules.guard: any live input emits the first value after connection setup
rules.explanation: Only a next notification elects a winner. Losing subscriptions are cancelled synchronously and never resume.
rules.nextState: The winning input alone remains live; its index is permanent.

rules.guard: value is from selected winner subscription
rules.explanation: Once a winner is chosen all its subsequent values are forwarded; first value is not the end of the race subscription.

rules.guard: any racing input completes without a prior next
rules.explanation: A completion before any first next closes the downstream subscriber. It does not select a continuing winner.

rules.guard: any racing input errors before any first next
rules.explanation: A failure before a first value fails the result and tears down every live candidate.
rules.nextState: Closed in error without a winner.

rules.explanation: Completion from the selected winner terminates the result.
rules.nextState: Closed successfully, original winner remains recorded.

rules.explanation: The winner is not protected from subsequent errors.

rules.explanation: Downstream owns the subscriptions and may cancel them all.
